Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Classic Teal Sea Fan Coral Coastal Print Wall Art Decor - 23" x 23" Picture Frame, White
Colors: Multicolor
Materials: paper
Bring an element of the ocean in to your home with this framed print of a sea fan, a type of coral. In keeping with the coastal theme, this piece is housed in a crisp white frame, ready to add a clean, modern splash of color to your room. 23"W x 23"H Print on paper in polystyrene frame with white finish Modern print of watercolor sea life Ready to hang, all hardware included
